name: Spider-Man (Stealth Suit)

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.
abilityDetails.Fragility: Gelen saldırıların kritik hasar oranını artırır ve blok yeterliliğini %50 azaltır.

signatureAbility:
S.H.I.E.L.D. Enhanced Spider
Increases the Potency of Fury Passives by [10 - 40]%.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Spider-Man gains +[1,833.33] Critical Rating versus Sinister Six and Symbiote champions.
When a Web Cartridge Debuff is replaced, gain a Fury Passive increasing Attack Rating by [16,866] for 25 seconds.
Spider-Man uses his web-shooters at point-blank range for his first and fourth Light Attacks. These hits do not make contact.

abilitySections.title: Spider-Sense
content: Spider-Man begins the fight with a Spider-Sense Charge granting him a Passive 70% chance to Evade incoming Basic Attacks when not Blocking.
When Spider-Man Evades an attack, Spider-Sense goes on cooldown for 25 seconds.
Dodging or Evading incoming hits pauses Fury and Precision Passives for 3.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: S.H.I.E.L.D. Web-Shooters - Pre-Fight Ability
content: Spider-Man has 1 Persistent Charge which can be consumed before the fight to load either a Tranquilizer, Web-Foam, or Flash Bang Cartridge into his web-shooters. Only 1 type of Cartridge may be loaded.
Spider-Man starts the fight with 5 Charges of his loaded Web Cartridge.
If no Cartridge type is loaded, Spider-Man brings in Flash Bang Web Cartridges by default.
Spider-Man expends Web Cartridge Charges inflicting Web Cartridge Debuffs when striking with Light Attack 4 or Special Attack 2.
At the start of the fight, gain back 1 Persistent Charge if it was spent.

abilitySections.title: S.H.I.E.L.D. Web Cartridge Debuffs
content: Tranquilizer - 100% chance to inflict Enervate preventing the Opponent from gaining Power when struck for 3.75 seconds.
Web-Foam - 100% chance to inflict a Slow Debuff. While the opponent is Slowed Spider-Man cannot Miss.
Flash Bang - 100% chance to inflict a Fragility Debuff. When attacking a Fragile Opponent, increase Critical Damage Rating by [1,546.88] and decrease their Block Proficiency by 50% for 12 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Re-activates Spider-Sense if it is on cooldown.
If Spider-Sense is not on cooldown, gain a Precision Passive increasing Critical Rating by [11,000] for 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The last two hits of this attack each expend a Web Cartridge Charge to inflict a Web Cartridge Debuff. These Debuffs have 250% duration.
The duration increase lasts until a Web Cartridge Debuff expires. Debuffs that are replaced do not count as having expired.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain back all spent Web Cartridge Charges.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - S.H.I.E.L.D. Enhanced Spider
content: Increases the Potency of Fury Passives by [10 - 40]%.
